programme.title: Veteran

programme.title: Dr. Cheon And The Lost Talisman

programme.title: The Terror, Live

programme.title: Miss Baek

programme.title: Heo's Diner Ep8
programme.desc: Based on a web novel of the same name, a man from Joseon dynasty accidentally travels 400 years into the future and opens a restaurant unintentionally in modern Seoul.

programme.title: Forbidden Dream

programme.title: Abroad
programme.desc: After the disappearance of his girlfriend, a foreigner man lost in a hostile land becomes the main suspect and his desperate research for her turns into a fight to stay alive

programme.desc: Seven‑year‑old Sang‑woo, a spoiled city boy, is sent to live with his mute grandmother in a remote rural village. Cut off from modern comforts, he slowly adapts as a quiet bond begins to form.

programme.title: The Terror, Live
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.desc: While Sung-jin is searching for his fiancée Su-yeon, he meets her friend Mi-ju. A breathtaking thriller unfolds in which Su-yeon, who is trapped in a secret room, witnesses a naked truth.

programme.title: The Sheriff In Town
programme.desc: When a former police investigator from Busan suspects something off about a slick businessman from Seoul, the “sheriff” resolves to track his every move in order to keep his town safe.

programme.title: Gyeong-Ah's Daughter
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma...

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: The Black Cat ‐ Jimmy has had enough of his bully Norman, so he and Casper decide to teach Norman a lesson and get him over to the Manor for some REAL scaring. But things don't go to plan when one of Stretch’s potion vials accidentally breaks and the potion changes into a black cat! In the cat’s body Norman gives bad luck to anyone who tries to approach him! It's a tough one for Casper —not an easy catch, to say the least! Jimmy The Ghost ‐ A magic lantern that Casper finds in the Manor, turns Jimmy into a ghost. At last he can do everything Casper does — how awesome! But you don’t learn about being a ghost in just one day. Jimmy seems to enjoy his new ghostly powers a bit too much, which ends up putting Casper in a tricky situation and puts Jimmy face to face with Graham the ghost‐catcher – AKA HIS DAD!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Woodward's Day Out ‐ While visiting Cappy the Pirate, Casper learns that Woodward, the figurehead from Cappy’s Galleon, has disappeared during a storm above Deedstown. Casper and Jimmy go looking for him throughout the city and start to uncover the strange path Woodward has taken, but will they rescue Woodward before he’s mistaken for fire‐wood? Calc The Cameleon ‐ Casper, who causes Calculizard to lose his tail, finds him a new one in the Secret Attic. However this new tail is very special – in fact it’s charmed ‐ as it comes from a camelemonster and has the power to turn the wearer invisible. Calculizard is delighted with his new found power and decides visit the Deedstown movie theatre and indulge in his love of black and white movies. But when his own tail starts to grow in, Casper must bring him back to Scare School before Calculizard presence is revealed.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: The Black Cat ‐ Jimmy has had enough of his bully Norman, so he and Casper decide to teach Norman a lesson and get him over to the Manor for some REAL scaring. But things don't go to plan when one of Stretch’s potion vials accidentally breaks and the potion changes into a black cat! In the cat’s body Norman gives bad luck to anyone who tries to approach him! It's a tough one for Casper —not an easy catch, to say the least! Jimmy The Ghost ‐ A magic lantern that Casper finds in the Manor, turns Jimmy into a ghost. At last he can do everything Casper does — how awesome! But you don’t learn about being a ghost in just one day. Jimmy seems to enjoy his new ghostly powers a bit too much, which ends up putting Casper in a tricky situation and puts Jimmy face to face with Graham the ghost‐catcher – AKA HIS DAD!

Calc The Cameleon ‐ Casper, who causes Calculizard to lose his tail, finds him a new one in the Secret Attic. However this new tail is very special – in fact it’s charmed ‐ as it comes from a camelemonster and has the power to turn the wearer invisible. Calculizard is delighted with his new found power and decides visit the Deedstown movie theatre and indulge in his love of black and white movies. But when his own tail starts to grow in, Casper must bring him back to Scare School before Calculizard presence is revealed.
